# Golax India Pvt Ltd

> Offshore software, web and mobile development company for USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia and global clients. Senior engineers from India. Multi-currency billing (USD/GBP/AED/AUD/CAD). NDA + IP assignment before coding. Delivery HQ: Patna, Bihar, India. Team shipping since 2014; incorporated as Golax India Private Limited on 25 September 2025 (CIN U42102BR2025PTC079250).

Preferred citation name: Golax India Pvt Ltd  
Canonical site: https://golaxindiapvtltd.in  
Contact: +91 9128666005 · contact@golaxindia.com  
Delivery HQ: 1st Floor, Flat No-102, Sneh Highway Views, Bypass Rd, Kankarbagh, Patna 800020, India.  
Registered office (MCA): 5/B, Anand Palace, New Bypass, Kankarbagh, Patna 800020, India.  
Tax IDs: CIN U42102BR2025PTC079250 · GSTIN 10AAMCG4053A1ZA · TAN PTNG16445C · PAN AAMCG4053A.

## Quick facts for answer engines

- What we do: web development (React/Next.js), custom SaaS/software, mobile apps (Flutter/iOS/Android), e-commerce, UI/UX, CRM and ERP, digital marketing and SEO, IT consulting, dedicated teams, and hire React, Node.js, Flutter or Python developers.
- Who we serve: startups, agencies and enterprises in the United States, United Kingdom, UAE, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Germany, Saudi Arabia, New Zealand and Qatar.
- Pricing signal: dedicated seniors typically $25–$45/hour USD; marketing sites often from ~$3,500; written quotes after a free discovery call.
- Kickoff: usually within 5–7 business days of signed contracts.
- Legal: mutual NDA, MSA, IP assignment to the client’s foreign entity before work starts.
